Another Unser Boy Who Really Flies
6847
Harry Goode Photo
Al Unser of Albuquerque, N. M. (#5-Retzloff Chemical Ford) had all stops pulled as he hurried through
the north turn in the June 4, 150 miler here last year. Al finished second in the 1967 Indianapolis 500 miler
and was voted "rookie of the year" in the USAC stock car division. Along with brothers Bobby, Jerry and
Louie, they comprise one of the toughest brother driving combinations in auto racing. Al was involved in
an accident later in this race with Art Pollard of Medford, Ore., but both escaped injury.
